name: the public library
intro: The public library. Warm. Somebody is paying for the heating, and it is not anybody here.
Terminals over there. Thirty minutes each, for people who exist.
H shows how the room is wired.
introTouch: The public library. Warm. Somebody is paying for the heating, and it is not anybody here.
Terminals over there. Thirty minutes each, for people who exist.
HACK shows how the room is wired.

pages: I sit for a minute. The radiator ticks. Nobody verifies anything.
It is the warmest I have been since Tuesday.

readables.name: NOTICE BOARD
pages: PUBLIC LIBRARY · DOWNTOWN BRANCH. COLLECTION DIGITIZED 2049. BUILDING RETAINED FOR SEATING.
PUBLIC TERMINALS: 30 MINUTES PER VERIFIED IDENTITY PER DAY. UNUSED MINUTES ARE NOT CARRIED OVER.

readables.name: REFERENCE ONLY
pages: A paper book, chained to its stand. The title has worn off the spine.
A bus ticket marks page 212. Yesterday it was page 211.

people.name: SHELF-E
talk: Re-shelving. One book. Correct place: everywhere.
Shelf 14 is empty. Shelf 15 is empty. I keep them in order.

people.name: LIBRARIAN
talk: Welcome to the public library. The books are on the cloud. The chairs are here.
People come for the chairs. And the radiators. Mostly the radiators.
No card? Then you are not in the system, and I cannot lend you anything.
I can lend you a chair. Chairs are not in the system. I checked.
That printer has been printing the same overdue notice for eleven years.
Staff's. Nobody can cancel it. The staff left. The notice stayed. Like the rest of us.
If something comes back to this library after eleven years, I will not ask where it has been.
I will stamp it. I have been waiting to stamp something since 2049.

people.name: TERMINAL 1
talk: Twelve minutes left. I am writing a thesis on why we need more than thirty minutes.
Eleven.
Do not stand behind me. I think the timer counts people who stand behind me.
I have not checked. No time.

people.name: TERMINAL 2
talk: Three minutes. I am on level nine.
If you do not talk to me I can finish level nine.
My mum is verified. I am her thirty minutes. She is at work. Do not tell the timer.

people.name: REGULAR
talk: ...not asleep. Reading. With my eyes closed. It saves the eyes.
Forty years I came here for the books. Now I come for the chair.
The chair is better. The chair never ended badly.

people.name: REGULAR
talk: I come for the radiator. Do not tell the radiator.
It is a scarf. For the radiator. It gets cold in February. Everything does.
The heating has been over budget every February since they digitized the books.
Nobody turns it down. The committee would never allow it. We are the committee.

people.name: REGULAR
talk: The last paper newspaper. I am reading it slowly.
If you only read this one, nothing new has happened since. It is very restful.
